1.consolidated_definition: Comer en demasía; hartarse …, con apoyo analógico típicamente campesino, … ya en Alonso: “Después de yenal ey buche.”
1.en_consolidated_definition: To eat excessively; gorge oneself …, with typically rural analogical support, … after eating until one's stomach is full.
